def process(conflict):
    import pandas as pd
    df = conflict.copy()
    # Ensure numeric
    df['StartYear'] = pd.to_numeric(df['StartYear'], errors='coerce')
    df['EndYear'] = pd.to_numeric(df['EndYear'], errors='coerce')

    # Duration at least 1 year: EndYear - StartYear >= 1
    df = df[df['StartYear'].notna() & df['EndYear'].notna()]
    df = df[(df['EndYear'] - df['StartYear']) >= 1]

    # Between 800 and 1400 AD inclusive (both endpoints)
    df = df[(df['StartYear'] >= 800) & (df['EndYear'] <= 1400)]

    return df[['Conflict','StartYear','EndYear']]

def process(conflict) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    df = conflict.copy()
    # coerce years
    df['StartYear'] = pd.to_numeric(df['StartYear'], errors='coerce')
    df['EndYear'] = pd.to_numeric(df['EndYear'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['StartYear','EndYear'])
    df['StartYear'] = df['StartYear'].astype(int)
    df['EndYear'] = df['EndYear'].astype(int)

    # inclusive window 800-1400 and duration at least 1 year
    df = df[(df['StartYear'] >= 800) & (df['EndYear'] <= 1400) & ((df['EndYear'] - df['StartYear']) >= 1)]

    # define conflict as between two actors: require a hyphen between actors in the Conflict string
    # (exclude parentheses-only internal conflicts like 'England (revolt)')
    s = df['Conflict'].astype(str)
    has_two_actors = s.str.contains(r'\s-\s|-', regex=True)
    df = df[has_two_actors]

    return df[['Conflict','StartYear','EndYear']].reset_index(drop=True)
input.summary: Filter conflicts to 800–1400 AD inclusive with numeric StartYear/EndYear, duration >=1 year, and require two actors indicated by '-' in Conflict string; keep Conflict, StartYear, EndYear.

def process(conflict) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    df = conflict.copy()
    # coerce years
    df['StartYear'] = pd.to_numeric(df['StartYear'], errors='coerce')
    df['EndYear'] = pd.to_numeric(df['EndYear'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['StartYear','EndYear'])
    df['StartYear'] = df['StartYear'].astype(int)
    df['EndYear'] = df['EndYear'].astype(int)

    # filter to 800-1400 inclusive (both endpoints within range)
    df = df[(df['StartYear'] >= 800) & (df['EndYear'] <= 1400)]

    # duration at least 1 year: treat as inclusive years => (EndYear - StartYear) >= 1
    df = df[(df['EndYear'] - df['StartYear']) >= 1]

    # require two actors: conflict string contains '-' between actors; exclude parenthetical-only dashes via simple contains
    df = df[df['Conflict'].astype(str).str.contains('-', regex=False)]

    return df[['Conflict','StartYear','EndYear']].reset_index(drop=True)
